rationale: This mutation resolves the -$11k cash deficit by implementing synchronous land-labor scaling to 20-24 plots for 11 hands, eliminating massive labor idling and unlocking $120k+ output potential. It enforces a strict Day-18 perennial cutoff to pivot late-game acreage to 3-day Carrots, institutes contract-duration feasibility gating on town shops to prevent stranded capital, and formalizes an in-situ harvest-and-water pipeline to maximize daily worker productivity. Finally, it calibrates liquidation to 16-20 item batches with a firm 0.82x price floor and purges phantom wheat reserves to optimize shed capacity.
